per_article_summaries: Williams team principal James Vowles reveals the team's weight problem. Vowles says the engineering work is done and the parts exist, at least on paper. The problem is converting these concepts into physical components under the constraints of the championship's cost cap. The FW48 is understood to have started the season much heavier than the team would have wanted.

The FIA has confirmed that changes to the engine hardware will be introduced in 2027. A 50 kW increase in power from the internal combustion engine and a decrease in the electric power of the same amount. This means that instead of the almost 50:50 split between internal combustion and electric power that the cars currently have, it will be closer to 60:40.

Will Buxton believes that Red Bull has regretted not signing Oscar Piastri as a junior driver. Piastri is being targeted as a potential replacement for four-time F1 champion Max Verstappen. Buxton's co-host and former W Series driver Naomi Schiff backed Piastri as a "good fit" for Red Bull.

Otmar Szafnauer says he tried to sign Kimi Raikkonen for Force India in 2012. The former team principal met the Finn at the season finale in Sao Paulo. Raikkonen left Ferrari at the end of 2009 and returned with Lotus in 2012. The Finn scored 390 points, 13 podium finishes and won two races.

Jenson Button has reflected on the tumultuous period at Honda during the 2007 and 2008 Formula 1 seasons. The 2009 world champion opened up about the struggles that the Japanese manufacturer faced following his maiden F1 victory at the 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix. Button described the 2007 season as an absolute disaster.

Apple's senior vice president of services Eddy Cue believes Formula 1 has the opportunity for long-term expansion in the United States. Cue: "I think there is a huge opportunity. It's not a 10% or 20%. I think it's a 'how many times X can we grow it over the years?'"

Juan Pablo Montoya says Peter 'Bono' Bonnington is a 'big part' of Kimi Antonelli's form at Mercedes. The 19-year-old is the youngest driver to lead the championship in F1 history. Antonelli is now 20 points clear of team-mate George Russell in second.

Daniel Ricciardo has opened up about his adjustment to life away from the Formula 1 grid. The eight-time grand prix winner retired from F1 after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix. Ricciardo is now a brand ambassador for Ford and runs his own brand.
